name: NBA role shift — teammates' volume props when a rotation player is out
hypothesis: When a top-8 rotation player is ruled OUT or DOUBTFUL, the market under-adjusts his teammates' volume props (rebounds, assists, 3-pointers made, points + rebounds + assists). An injury-conditioned regime, the existing props model fed with each teammate's minutes and per-minute rates from games without the absent player (shrunk toward the full-roster numbers), prices them closer to the close, so flags where its fair probability beats the posted price by 2.5 pp or more show positive CLV.
objective: Measure whether injury-conditioned fair lines anticipate the market's adjustment, graded against the closing price at the same book and line, with the actual stat stored beside every grade. Research only: no flag is a recommendation.
primary_metric: Mean CLV in percentage points over graded role-shift flags, CLV = the closing Shin no-vig probability of the flag's side at the same book and the same line minus the flag's cost (1 / decimal price, vig included), with its game-clustered 95% bootstrap interval. The actual stat and the over/under/push/void outcome are stored and reported, not the criterion.
unit: One flag: one teammate, one market, one side at one posted line, one book. Clusters: the game (event_id).
baseline: The default props model (nba/props/build_props.js, the previous-game rotation) and the market itself: no edge means mean CLV at most 0.
training_window: None fitted for the regime: the props model is the existing one (trained on the four seasons before the current); the regime's splits use this season and last, as of each trigger.
validation_window: None. There is no tuning step.
holdout_window: Every role-shift flag from the first one onward. Evaluated at 200 graded flags and every 100 after; the repeated looks are disclosed.

machine.window_note: [from, to): open-ended; the flag table is append-only

minimum_sample.note: Below 200 graded flags the record is descriptive. Every flag counts, losses included.

promotion_criteria.decision_rule: eligible = true only if BOTH criteria hold on the graded flags at the time of evaluation. A criterion that cannot be evaluated is not met. Eligibility does not promote the model: a person promotes it to VALIDATED through a validation report. Software tests passing is never evidence for any criterion.

criteria.rule: At least 200 graded flags (close_status = 'graded'). Flags with no usable close are counted and reported (the no-close count and rate), never graded and never counted toward the 200.

The lower end of the two-sided 95% percentile interval of the mean CLV (pp, flag-weighted) is above zero. The interval is a cluster bootstrap that resamples whole GAMES (event_id) with replacement: 2,000 resamples, mulberry32 seeded 20261026 (lib/edgedesk_sharp_lag.js clusterBootstrap), because flags in one game share its news and its close and are not independent.

promotion_criteria.family_correction: Both are required (an intersection test); neither is reported as a pass on its own.

candidates_tried.trigger: top-8 rotation player to OUT or DOUBTFUL
candidates_tried.splits: game-level primary, stints as the cross-check

alternatives_considered_not_tried: the props model's own learned absence feature (miss_proj) instead of with/without splits
forking_paths.choice_and_reason: The owner's specification: game-level splits primary (every stat exists per game; rebounds do not exist per stint), stints as the cross-check, 3-pointers made as modelled attempts times the shrunk 3P%, 2.5 pp.
forking_paths.data_already_seen: No NBA prop price has ever been captured (the gateway's NBA row is disabled), so no role-shift flag has been computed or graded.
forking_paths.stopping_rule: No stopping: the record runs on. Eligibility is evaluated at 200 graded flags and every 100 after.

spec.trigger: nba_injury_sync records a top-8 rotation player (reference rotation minutes, nba/roster_inputs.json) moving to OUT or DOUBTFUL
spec.splits: per teammate: minutes, usage (FGA + 0.44 FTA + TOV), FGA, 3PA, REB, AST, PTS per game in games WITHOUT the absent player vs WITH him, this season and last; shrunk = (n_without x without + k x with) / (n_without + k), k = 10 games; stints (on-court minutes, FGA, 3PA, assists) as the cross-check, reported beside, never overriding
spec.regime: the existing props model's prediction with minutes and per-minute rates from the shrunk splits (the default model and its output unchanged); 3-pointers made = modelled 3PA x the player's 3P% shrunk toward the league rate with 100 attempts
spec.prices: one nba_role_props request per game (player_rebounds, player_assists, player_threes, player_points_rebounds_assists; ten books, one region-equivalent, <= 4 credits), stored for the 3-4 teammates with the largest minutes or usage change
spec.flag: regime P(side at the posted line) - 1 / posted decimal >= 2.5 pp, at the first book posting the line in the order draftkings, fanduel, betmgm, williamhill_us, espnbet, betrivers, fanatics, hardrockbet, betonlineag, pinnacle; never the absent player's own unders
spec.grade: close = the same book's last two-way price at the same line at or before the tip, at most 90 minutes before it (else no close); CLV = closing Shin no-vig P(side) - flag cost; actual = the player's stat (void if he did not play)
known_limitations: the scenarios are built ahead, one per top-8 rotation player, in the 3-hourly NBA build and switched on when the report lands, so their inputs can be up to 3 hours old; a build more than 24 hours old switches nothing on
per-stint rebounds are not in the play-by-play stints
sample sizes without a player can be small: shrinkage is fixed, not fitted
a line that moves is graded only if the same line closes at the same book
